content.value: Suppose two nodes start to transmit at the same time a packet of length L over a broadcast (08) channel of rate R. Denote the propagation delay between the two nodes as $d _ { p r o p }$ . What there be a collision if $d _ { p r o p } > \frac { L } { R }$ ? Why or why not.
